property_summary: For any caller and any bytes32 hash and any msg.value, the reference contract only accepts a lockInGuess call when exactly 1 ether is sent (calls with other values revert); the mutant removes this check and therefore accepts calls with msg.value != 1 ether.
change_summary: Remove the requirement that msg.value equals 1 ether, allowing calls with different msg.value to set the guess and block.
